title: Preflight exact C6c dual-platform certification on published V4 1.1.3
goal: Establish whether the C6b1 exact IFX candidate and fresh evidence locks can be certified on Windows and pinned offline Linux without weakening policy or claiming synthetic review as approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Freeze the C6b1 candidate identity, current source commit, published 1.1.3 base and pinned Linux runner/toolchain identity.
Run the approved same-commit Windows-full and offline Linux-complete platform suites where feasible, recording exact reports or a precise blocking condition.
Record whether the seven short-lived IFX evidence locks, including exact SDK 10.0.303 evaluated graph, can be produced and consumed on both platforms without modifying candidate or authority bytes.
Pass Formal Pre, isolated package regression and exact committed Formal Diff on only the declared documentation paths; do not claim C6c certification, human approval or cutover.
